dog.description_text:
Meet Roney, a striking 2-year-old cream Golden Retriever who's ready to bring adventure and joy into your home! 🐕 I'm a solid 70-pound bundle of energy and playfulness — already neutered and raring to go on whatever comes next. I thrive with active families and do wonderfully with children, so if you've got the stamina to keep up with me, I'm your guy. My adoption fee is $185, and I promise you'll never have a dull moment. Come meet me and let's start our adventure together! 🌟
This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application.Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
